_note: MIRROR + HS6 fallback for the ~45 countries that only have MIRROR data (Syria, Tajikistan, Vietnam, Bangladesh, Cuba, Bhutan, Suriname…). ROOT CAUSE proven live 2026-08-21 from the run log: navigating .../6/direct/... REDIRECTS to .../6/mirror/... — these countries do NOT report their own (Direct) data, so Trade Map only serves reconstructed MIRROR data, which exists only at HS6 (partners report at HS6, not the importer's NTL). So source='mirror' + detail='HS6' here (NOT direct/NTL — that is why the NTL run failed them with FILTER_DRIFT on source). This is NOT a compliance bypass: mirror is the ONLY data Trade Map offers for them; the old 'mirror disabled for byProduct' note was for a Direct-reporting country. Own input list (input/countries-no-ntl.xlsx) + own manifest (latest-run-hs6-fallback.json) → fully INDEPENDENT, never touches the 143 finished files, order-agnostic. Run: npm run batch -- --config config/config.production-hs6-fallback.json  (resume-safe). Files carry HS6-...-Mirror so they never collide with the Direct/NTL files.
